file.description: Absolute path to the generated video file

primary.name: mcode-tools
primary.notes: Cloud-hosted cinematic video generation via mcode-tools CLI. Async submit + poll pattern (max wait 600s, poll every 10s). Output is silent -- the audio-voice plugin adds narration in a separate step.

fallbacks.name: local-ffmpeg-color
fallbacks.notes: 1-second ffmpeg lavfi color frame matching the requested aspect ratio. Cheap placeholder that satisfies the contract.

fallbacks.name: local-placeholder-text
fallbacks.notes: Plain-text file (last-ditch) when ffmpeg is not on PATH either. The engine will see it as an invalid mp4 and the operator can spot the failure in the audit log.
